# Neucler

> AI-powered lead conversion platform for service businesses

## About
Neucler transforms inbound calls into booked revenue through AI-powered lead scoring, automated follow-ups, and front desk coaching. We help service businesses (especially auto repair shops) convert more leads without hiring additional staff.

## Core Features
- **Post-Call Performance Scoring**: Every call graded on 17+ metrics including speed, knowledge, and closing ability
- **Unified Support Inbox**: Consolidate SMS, Email, and Calls with priority-based routing
- **Automated SOP Playbook**: Digital knowledge base with pricing rules and best practices
- **Missed Call Rescue**: Instant text-back to capture leads before they go elsewhere
- **Dispute Protection**: Searchable transcripts and audio logs
- **Smart Waitlist**: Auto-fill cancelled slots by texting your waitlist

## How It Works
1. **Capture & Understand**: Analyze inbound calls for intent, urgency, and buying signals
2. **Score & Prioritize**: Every caller is scored and categorized for follow-up prioritization
3. **Automate Follow Up**: Personalized, intent-aware follow-ups until the lead books
4. **Train Your Front Desk**: Turn insights into coaching moments with real call examples
5. **Improve Over Time**: Data-driven optimization showing what behaviors drive bookings
